ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) pixels comprising approximately 65-70% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) mottling accounting for the remaining 30-35%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-contrast white mottling concentrated in the central-medial region of both lobes. Distinct high-intensity contiguous blobs are present along the inner margins near the median notch. The right lobe exhibits vertical, linear white streaking compared to the amorphous mottling on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-based angle of 35 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable amplitude across the trailing edge. The left lobe displays jagged, irregular peaks, while the right lobe shows a more rhythmic, lower-amplitude wave pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve with a sharp, tapered upward sweep toward the distal tips, notably pronounced on the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity punctate spots visible on the distal tips and scattered across the central ventral area, particularly near the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three prominent, parallel, dark-pigmented linear marks crossing the mid-section of the left lobe at a ~45-degree angle relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the left lobe. Presence of orange-pigmented sessile organisms (barnacles) clustered on the far left distal tip and along the upper trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water turbulence and spray partially occlude the upper boundary of the fluke, though the primary structural contour remains differentiable from the background.
